_note: Fictional couple for development and tests. Sam is 'me' (right-side bubbles), Rio is 'them'.

messages.text: hi, is this sam?
it is! is this rio from the bookshop line?
the one who dropped every single book, yes
you caught the last one though. very heroic
coffee sometime? as thanks for not laughing
i absolutely laughed. but yes
running 5 min late, the bus is crawling
no rush, i got us the window seat
that was really nice. same time next week?
same time next week
found a café that does lavender lattes. is that a crime
only if you don't take me. i would die for a lavender latte
café lumen. on fourth street. noted
my mom asked who keeps making me smile at my phone
tell her it's the clumsy one from the bookshop
i think you're my favorite person to text
good because i've been drafting this one for an hour
can i say something
always
i love you. that's it. that's the text
i love you too. i was waiting for you to go first
it's midnight and i'm grinning at the ceiling
goodnight bean
bean??
you're small and you're a lot. bean
i accept
bean reporting: i made the pasta and it's edible
proud of you bean
beach saturday? forecast says sun
packing snacks already
i'm still sandy. worth it
ok. tuesday oct 14. picnic at the lake. i'm planning everything
you're planning?? who are you
someone with a basket and a dream
have you looked outside
it's biblical out there
picnic is cancelled. the lake is now part of the sky
rain check?
rain check. literally
counteroffer: café lumen at 3. two lavender lattes. i'll bring an umbrella
you remembered!!
i mentioned that once in april
i remember everything you say. it's a problem
outside. bad news about the umbrella
what's wrong with it
it's a tiny umbrella. the tiny umbrella fits one (1) person
then we share it badly
my left side is soaked and i'd do it again
2 lavender lattes, 1 tiny umbrella, 0 regrets
best rain check ever
goodnight my love. a match made on a rainy tuesday
it's drizzling, bringing the tiny umbrella
so i'm getting wet again. cool cool
saw a tiny umbrella in a cocktail and thought of you
is it bigger than ours
honestly yes
merry christmas! open the long box first
SAM. A FULL SIZE UMBRELLA
i'm keeping the tiny umbrella though. it's tradition
snow day. no umbrella required
building a very small snowman in solidarity with the tiny umbrella
dinner at 7? i booked the place with the candles
i'll wear the red sweater
one year since 'hi, is this sam?'
best text anyone ever sent me
i rewrote it eleven times
happy one year
apartment tour at 4. bring the tiny umbrella for luck
the tiny umbrella has never brought luck. only dampness
we got it!!! the one with the window
WE GOT IT
moving day. why do we own 400 books
i dropped them all once. now we carry them for my sins
late night thought: i like our life
me too. go to sleep
found the tiny umbrella in the moving box marked misc
misc?? it's a family heirloom
it's supposed to rain on the 14th. lumen?
lumen. 2 lavender lattes. one tiny umbrella
a year of sharing it badly
